the-bystander-harm-licenses-no-foreclosu.note: Cold-graded: axes committed from B1 intrinsic per-axis merit BEFORE sibling comparison (K162/K163 discipline); sibling RSI observed post-commit as sanity only, axes NOT adjusted to slot between siblings. v.90 — tight structure (harm-principle gate -> narrowest-instrument -> arena-routing; the impeach-right / arena-only fork is a clean dilemma; the aggregate proves-too-much move closes the re-aggregation probe), held off .91 by a soft spot in the pivotal 'arena-policy reaches the cost' premise (already-realized and interim displacement is not fully reached by a downstream eligibility rule). s.87 — the load-bearing premises are defended, not axiomatic (proportionality is standard liberal least-restrictive-means; the fork, the backfire-sort, and the aggregate parity are argued/exemplified), but the 'reaches the cost' premise carries heavy weight with a real un-neutralized residue (the cis athlete who already lost the final; the pre-rule interim), keeping s below S4's .88. c.87 — completeness relative-to-objection: sorts the family (sport / spaces / vulnerable-population), runs all three prongs, handles the fork and the re-aggregation retreat, sorts backfire honestly (bites in space, weak in sport); the routed-out category-eligibility and safeguarding questions are NOT c-gaps (S3/S4 precedent: routing a residual to the correct downstream adjudicator is not a c-penalty); the minor residue (interim/already-realized displacement) is what holds c off higher. r.85 — THE contested axis and the one that lands the headline. The core claim (the arena-cost does not license foreclosing the right) is hard to defeat: proportionality is tight, the fork closes the retreats, the aggregate proves-too-much closes the strongest probe. BUT two genuine costs hold r at .85: (i) the wing's HEAVIEST honest residual — the routed-out questions (elite-sport eligibility under retained advantage; vulnerable-population safety) are real, substantial, and unresolved, and a determined reader experiences the win as the narrowest in the wing; (ii) the pivotal 'reaches the cost' premise has an un-neutralized exception (already-realized/interim displacement) that is a dent, not mere narrowness. r.85 (not .86) is decisive: at r=.86 the long geomean clears 0.88 (A); at r=.85 it lands 0.8797 (B). S2 A-long via arguendo-concession-then-defeat). The B is axes-driven: the wing's heaviest honest residual depresses r and the geomean falls fractionally under 0.88.
